back: The Bolshevik secret police, set up in December 1917 and led by Dzerzhinsky.

front: What happened to the Constituent Assembly?
back: It met in January 1918 and was closed by the Bolsheviks the next day.

front: When was the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk signed?
back: 3 March 1918; Russia lost Poland, Finland, the Baltic lands and Ukraine.
Bolshevik policy of 1918-21: grain requisitioning, nationalisation, rationing and a ban on private trade.
Policy of 1921: tax instead of requisitioning, private trade and small businesses allowed, state kept the commanding heights.
A rebellion by sailors near Petrograd in March 1921, crushed by the Red Army.

front: Why did the Reds win the Civil War?
back: Central position and railways, Trotsky's Red Army, unity and terror, and divided, scattered Whites.
